definitions: To release one's grip on something or someone.
To stop thinking about or being angry about a past event or something someone said.
To allow something to pass or escape without intervention.
examples: She had to let go of the rope.
You need to let go of that grudge.
The company had to let go of several employees.
He decided to let go of the opportunity.
pastTenses: let go (past simple), let go (present perfect)
